annotations.title: From a list of beers, return the ones a user has NOT had

description: Given a list of beer ids, return only the ones the user has NOT had — the "what here is new to me?" filter for a venue menu, a brewery lineup, or a festival list. Consults BOTH cached sources; reads the cache only, NO API call. Returns the not-had bids (plus the had bids and counts) and cache freshness. Run untappd_sync_user_beers first; if coverage is incomplete the freshness caveat flags that a "not had" may be a false negative.

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).

name: untappd_cache_not_had
